title: Sync from live: field values, versions and 404 rows follow a renumbered record, synced files belong to the webroot's owner, a sync cut off by a deploy says so and is settled by the next press, and a busy live site is named as busy
steps: S1: node --test --test-reporter=tap packages/fleet/tracy-fleet-operation/test/live-sync-ids.test.mjs packages/fleet/tracy-fleet-operation/test/live-sync-flow.test.mjs packages/fleet/tracy-fleet-operation/test/webroot-own.test.mjs (needs a docker daemon for mariadb:11)
expect: S1: 'field values, versions and 404 log rows follow a renumbered article; neither log holds the sync' passes: live's article 3 → 4 carries its fields_values rows (item_id '4'), its #__history row comes over under a new version_id with item_id com_content.article.4, both #__redirect_links rows are kept, nothing is held; an extension's VARCHAR and TEXT item_id pointing at the renumbered article is held.
S1: 'the customer’s live changes and the agent’s copy changes both end up in the copy' passes: every path the sync wrote and every folder it made is chowned to the webroot's uid:gid.

S1: the three 'a cut-off apply' tests pass: nothing written → untouched, an agent's edit since kept; only the sync's writes → rolled back to Before restore, also when the next read is LIVE_BUSY; edited since → APPLY_INTERRUPTED_KEPT and nothing written; in place → finished, also after the 24 h sweep, and a large file edited since is not written over.
S1: 'a path under a symlinked folder that leaves the webroot is not chowned; a link itself is' passes; every flow test passes with a docker CLI that warns on stderr.
S1: 'a live site that kept changing is answered LIVE_BUSY; any other failed read LIVE_READ_FAILED' passes.
S2: 'a sync cut off by a host restart says so, and the next press starts at once (#1563)' and 'a live site that kept changing is filed LIVE_BUSY, also from a host that wraps it (#1564)' pass.
S3: 'every code the host or the door can end a sync with has words of its own or the generic sentence' passes: SYNC_INTERRUPTED, APPLY_INTERRUPTED_KEPT and LIVE_BUSY each have their own sentence.

selectors.files: lib/webroot-repo-git.sh tracy_webroot_own, webroot-git.sh restore_reset, webroot-sync.sh after_apply

evidence: QA on cowork.tracy.site 21/10/2026, seven sync rounds on an imported Joomla 4.4 site: issues #1560, #1561, #1562, #1563, #1564.
fence: A renumbered live record takes everything that names it along; files a sync writes are the web user's; a sync a restart cut off never leaves a half-applied copy; the owner is told the real reason a sync stopped.

tests: field values, versions and 404 log rows follow a renumbered article
the customer’s live changes and the agent’s copy changes both end up in the copy
a live site that kept changing is answered LIVE_BUSY
a sync cut off by a host restart says so
a live site that kept changing is filed LIVE_BUSY
every code the host or the door can end a sync with has words of its own
a path under a symlinked folder that leaves the webroot is not chowned
